gcu.title: General Conditions of Use
gcu.purpose: The WestMarches App is a free, open source application that allows users to create and manage map-based notes for role-playing campaigns.

access.title: Access & Accounts
access.text: Use of the App requires account creation with an email and password. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login details.

userContent.title: User Content
userContent.text: You may add text-based content (tile details, notes). No moderation is performed. You remain responsible for the content you enter. The owner claims no rights over user content.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.text: The App’s source code is open source and available on GitHub under the license specified in the repository’s LICENSE file.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.text: The App does not include communication features between users. You agree not to misuse the App for illegal purposes or attempts to disrupt its functioning.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: The App is provided 'as is', without warranties of any kind. The owner is not liable for downtime, data loss, or any damages resulting from the use of the App.

termination.title: Termination
termination.text: The App does not provide account suspension or deletion by the owner. Users may stop using the App at any time.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: These Terms may be updated at any time. Continued use of the App constitutes acceptance of the new version.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how the WestMarches App collects, stores, and uses your information. By using the App, you agree to this policy.

dataCollected.title: Data We Collect
dataCollected.text: We collect your email address and password (encrypted) when you create an account. We also store text you enter into map tiles and related features. The App uses localStorage in your browser to manage session data.

dataUse.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUse.text: Your data is used only to allow you to log in, save your progress, and access your account. It is never sold or used for marketing purposes.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.text: The App uses Auth0 to generate JWT tokens for authentication. Data is hosted on a server provided by the project’s educational environment (AWS). We do not share your data with other third parties.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.text: Your data remains stored as long as your account exists. The App does not currently provide account deletion or automatic deletion of inactive accounts.

security.title: Security
security.text: Passwords are encrypted before storage. No system is fully secure; by using the App, you accept the risks inherent to online storage.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: As a user under EU law (GDPR), you may request access to your personal data, correction of errors, or deletion. Contact us at {email}.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Continued use of the App means you accept the updated policy.
